component.name: QWarp
component.summary: Desktop interface for Cloudflare WARP on Linux

description.p: QWarp is an independent desktop interface for the official Cloudflare WARP client on Linux. Connect or disconnect, choose connection modes, and manage DNS settings from your desktop or system tray.

QWarp supports Wayland and X11, optional launch at login, and multiple interface languages. It requires the official Cloudflare WARP client to be installed separately and does not implement or bundle the WARP service. QWarp is not affiliated with or endorsed by Cloudflare.
Fix missing SVG bindings in Debian and Ubuntu packages and improve missing-module diagnostics. Add application metadata for software centers.
Improve command validation, single-instance handling, diagnostic privacy, and connection status presentation.
Add split tunneling, local domain fallback DNS settings, and connection mode switching from the system tray.
